environment.description: Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise instance behind an F5 BIG-IP LTM virtual server. The virtual server has a Local Traffic Policy attached with a rule matching on TCP connections to the TFE API port (443). The policy condition uses an address-list data group ('allowed_cidr_ranges') containing only 10.200.0.0/16 and 172.16.44.0/24 (corporate VPN egress and CI/CD runner subnet). The policy action is 'forward' for matching source IPs and 'reset' for all others. The TFE instance API endpoint is not exposed via any other path. Additionally, the workspace is configured with Sentinel policy-as-code requiring that all plan configurations pass a regex check on resource attributes, though this Sentinel policy does not inspect the 'parallel_destroy' boolean field. The F5 pool member health monitor checks TFE /healthcheck endpoint every 5s.
